name: Legacy End Rings
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: XiaotianMC
description:
Reintroduces the classic End Void Ring generation from 26.3-snapshot-5 and below(MC-159283).
Restores the integer overflow behavior that created concentric void rings.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
